purpose: Leave a possibility open without asserting it.
keywords: Plain clause + かもしれない; nouns and な-adjectives omit だ.
I may have left my key at work.
That person might be the new teacher.
formation: Plain clause + かもしれない; nouns and な-adjectives omit だ.
restrictions: It indicates uncertainty rather than a fixed numerical probability.
mistake: Use 学生かもしれない, not 学生だかもしれない.
